witness_description: No counterexample exists in the swept labeled family model with exactly 3 men and 3 women.
refutation_explanation: Every woman has all 3 men as brothers, and each of those men has exactly the other 2 men as brothers. Thus every one of the 20 assignments satisfies the stated 3-men/3-women comparison.
search_space: All 20 labeled sex assignments obtained by choosing exactly 3 men among 6 non-parent family members; for every assignment, all 3 women and each of their 3 brothers were checked.
